description: This PHP source file generates a web page for the second step of a Home Network Wizard, allowing users to configure Wi-Fi network names, security modes, and passwords for both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands. It includes server-side PHP to retrieve current network settings, client-side JavaScript for form validation, dynamic UI updates, and form submission logic.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the Wi-Fi configuration data to the server to be saved, and displays a success message upon completion.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration string, and calls set_config() to save the network settings.
